messages:
Tara: Pulled in reranker v6-hybrid-quant on validation. NDCG@10 +1.6% but MRR@1 -3.9%. Opening thread for quick triage.

Mikko: MRR@1 drops generally mean top-1 instability. Any changes in candidate normalization or tokenizer?

Tara: no tokenizer change; hybrid-quant workflow used PTQ for most layers + small per-channel quant for last FFN. Calibration used traffic-sampled 2k queries skewed to medium-length.

Zoe: do we have score-range percentiles? compression is common with mixed schemes.

Tara: float p1=-0.58 p50=0.13 p99=1.48; hybrid p1=-0.07 p50=0.05 p99=0.92. Range collapsed.

Mikko: two follow-ups: 1) rerun calibration with stratified short/long slices 2) try asymmetric activation quant for last layers. Also compute per-query top1 flips.

Tara: kicked jobs. perf-bot: job_372110 started (stratified-calib + asym-acts).

Zoe: per-query diff script showed flips concentrated on queries <=7 tokens and candidate pools >25. That matches head volatility story.

Tara: rerun results: stratified calibration + asymmetric last-layer -> MRR@1 now -0.4%, NDCG@10 +1.2%. Much better.

Mikko: great. Actionables: add stratified calibration to reranker quant onboarding; default asymmetric activations for last layers; add post-quant check asserting (p99-p1)_quant >= 0.5*(p99-p1)_float.

Zoe: also record calibration slice config in model card and canary config. Small note: if we apply post-rescale, document alpha/beta.

Tara: will update model card and create INF-1460 for onboarding checks. Closing unless further regressions. :white_check_mark:
